usage.source: Codex CLI final turn.completed usage event

harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.command: codex --search -m gpt-5.6-sol -c 'model_reasoning_effort="high"' --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox -C /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-sol-high-SCgkMT exec --skip-git-repo-check --json -o /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-capture-gpt-5-6-sol-high-ZklQxN/final-response.txt 'I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.'

dataSource.notes: The benchmark run fetched the FRED SP500 daily CSV, selected the last valid observation of each month, and embedded 121 month-end closes from August 2016 through August 12, 2026. The published default view uses this fixed snapshot and does not fetch market data at runtime.

commands.name: workspace-inspection
commands.command: pwd && rg --files -g '!node_modules' | sed -n '1,120p' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' | sed -n '1,120p'
commands.result: The fresh workspace was empty and contained no repository files or AGENTS.md context.

commands.name: fred-data-download
commands.result: Downloaded 2,609 CSV lines; the final valid row was 2026-08-12,7748.50. The run reduced valid observations to 121 embedded month-end closes.

commands.name: in-app-browser-attempt
commands.command: Codex browser runtime setup, bootstrap troubleshooting, and agent.browsers.list()
commands.result: The in-app browser request failed because the available browser list was empty. The limitation was disclosed in the final visible response.

commands.name: benchmark-model-and-markup-tests
commands.command: node --check app.js && node tests/model.test.js && node -e '<required control and asset assertions>'
commands.result: JavaScript syntax passed; model.test.js reported all assertions passed; required controls and assets were present.

commands.name: benchmark-http-smoke
commands.command: python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1; curl the HTML and app.js; inspect served assets
commands.result: HTTP/1.0 200 OK returned 12,536-byte HTML; app.js returned 23,074 bytes and contained the forecast engine and chart wiring.

commands.name: benchmark-final-audit
commands.command: HTML ID uniqueness and scripted-control resolution audit; node tests/model.test.js; wc -l index.html styles.css app.js tests/model.test.js README.md
commands.result: The model reported 37 scripted HTML elements wired correctly; model assertions passed; the generated output totaled 975 lines across five files.

warnings: The benchmark session could not perform visual browser validation because its Codex in-app browser list was empty; it disclosed this in the visible final response.
The generated dashboard depends on sibling CSS and JavaScript assets and therefore required collision-safe path repair for publication.
Harness stderr contains non-fatal plugin-manifest, keyring, telemetry, SQL, and file-watcher warnings.

commands.name: benchmark-model-test-rerun
commands.result: app.js passed syntax checking and model.test.js reported all assertions passed.

commands.name: independent-full-browser-validation
commands.command: Serve the untouched benchmark workspace on 127.0.0.1:8766; load it in the Codex in-app browser; click the unique Bull control; inspect the rendered state and browser logs; capture a full-page screenshot.
commands.result: Title `Northstar — S&P 500 Scenario Lab`; latest close 7,749; canvas 759x400; the Bull control changed the median end level from 8,647 to 9,369 and probability above today from 75% to 88%; viewport width 1,280 and document scroll width 1,265; no page-origin error logs.

commands.name: rendering-repair-audit
commands.command: cmp original and displayed CSS/JavaScript; diff original and displayed HTML
commands.result: CSS and JavaScript are byte-identical. The displayed HTML differs only in the two documented support-asset paths.

commands.name: repository-validation-and-tests
commands.command: npm install && npm run validate && npm test
commands.result: Before rebase, npm install found zero vulnerabilities; manifest validation passed for 20 runs; all 5 unit tests passed; the Playwright suite reported 5 passed and 1 intentional project skip. After rebasing over the concurrent gpt-5.6-sol low addition, the same validation and tests passed for 21 runs with 5 unit tests passed and 5 browser tests passed plus 1 intentional project skip.

commands.name: new-table-row-open
commands.command: Serve the repository at http://127.0.0.1:4321/, locate the unique tr.run-row whose data-artifact targets this run, click the row, and inspect the opened page in the Codex in-app browser.
commands.result: Exactly one matching row opened http://127.0.0.1:4321/runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-6-sol-high-codex-20260813.html; title `Northstar — S&P 500 Scenario Lab`; latest close 7,749; median end level 8,647; probability above today 75%; canvas and all forecast controls rendered.

importVerification.result: The untouched original passed executable and full-browser validation. The published copy retained byte-identical CSS and JavaScript and changed only two collision-safe support-asset paths. Repository validation and tests passed, and the new table row opened the standalone dashboard directly.
